continuity.continuity_posture: A degraded or unavailable provider is handled so that governed meaning is preserved and no governed effect is silently lost.
continuity.substitution_posture: Introducing a replacement provider is a governed change, distinct from continuity, with its own trust establishment.
continuity.incident_linkage: Continuity and substitution events are linked to governed incident records.

data_return.return_posture: Governed data is returned in a usable, portable form as a distinct, evidenced obligation on termination.
data_return.portability_posture: Returned data is portable so that governed meaning survives the provider relationship.

deletion.deletion_evidence_posture: Deletion is evidenced; a provider assertion of deletion is a certification, not House confirmation.
deletion.residual_copy_posture: Residual copies, backups, and derivatives are explicitly addressed before deletion is treated as complete.

exit.exit_posture: Exit completes only when its constituent obligations are evidenced; otherwise it remains incomplete.
exit.termination_distinction: Provider termination is distinct from data return, deletion, and exit completion.
exit.exit_acceptance: Exit is accepted as closed only on evidence of return, deletion, and reconciliation.
